related_questions.question: How long should I wait to get the flu shot after having the flu?

text_blocks.snippet: It's generally recommended to wait at least two weeks after recovering from the flu before getting the flu shot. This waiting period allows your immune system to fully recover from fighting off the initial infection. Getting vaccinated while still sick can be less effective as your immune system is already busy.

list.title: Mild illness:
list.snippet: If you have a mild illness, like a runny nose or slight sore throat, you can likely get the flu shot.

list.title: Moderate to severe illness:
list.snippet: If you have a fever or more severe symptoms, it's best to wait until you've recovered before getting vaccinated.

list.title: Consult your doctor:
list.snippet: If you're unsure, it's always a good idea to consult your primary care provider for personalized advice.

text_blocks.snippet: While you can get the flu shot at the same time as a COVID-19 vaccine or booster, it's generally recommended to receive them in separate arms to minimize potential side effects.
